args.title: Add missing S3_ENDPOINT note to local setup steps
args.body:
File: README.md

Add a line in the 'Running locally' steps to specify the need to set S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 when using MinIO, to clarify the setup and prevent uploads mistakenly going to AWS.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is that the local setup steps in README.md do not mention that when using MinIO as the S3-compatible store, the environment variable S3_ENDPOINT must be set to http://localhost:9000 to avoid uploads going to AWS instead. Adding this line will improve clarity and prevent the error described.
